title: bf16 Rounding Silently Discards Most RL Policy Updates: A Hidden Training-Inference Mismatch and an Unbiased One-Line Fix
abstract: arXiv:2610.41073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of language models keeps fp32 master weights in the optimizer and serves rollouts from a bf16 copy produced by round-to-nearest conversion. At the learning rates in common use, most per-step updates are smaller than half a bf16 spacing and the conversion discards them: on Qwen3-1.7B only 0.4-0.5% of served weights change per step, and the policy that generates the training data lags the optimizer by 50-150 steps. Existing mismatch corrections cannot see this lag because they compare two copies downstream of the same rounding. We propose Fair Cast: export the master with an unbiased rounding rule (stochastic rounding or error feedback) and compute the training loss on the served copy. The change is one line at the export call, adds no hyperparameters and costs 22-38 ms per export of 1.7B parameters. Across 25 matched seed-pairs on Qwen3-0.6B to 4B with AdamW and Muon, Fair Cast is ahead on 18, tie

translated_title: bf16舍入悄然丢弃大部分RL策略更新：一个隐藏的训练-推理失配及一个无偏的单行修复
translated_abstract: 语言模型的强化学习（RL）后训练在优化器中保留fp32主权重，并通过四舍五入（round-to-nearest）转换得到的bf16副本来执行rollout推理。在常用的学习率下，大多数单步更新小于半个bf16间距，转换过程会将它们丢弃：在Qwen3-1.7B上，每步仅有0.4-0.5%的服务权重发生变化，且生成训练数据的策略落后于优化器50-150步。现有的失配校正方法无法察觉这种滞后，因为它们比较的是同一次舍入下游的两个副本。我们提出Fair Cast：使用无偏舍入规则（随机舍入或误差反馈）导出主权重，并在服务副本上计算训练损失。该改动仅需在导出调用处修改一行代码，不增加任何超参数，每次导出1.7B参数的成本仅为22-38毫秒。在Qwen3-0.6B至4B模型上使用AdamW和Muon优化器进行的25组匹配种子对实验中，Fair Cast在18组中领先……
tldr: 提出Fair Cast方法，通过在权重导出时采用无偏舍入规则（随机舍入或误差反馈），仅需一行代码即可修复RL后训练中bf16舍入悄然丢弃大部分策略更新所导致的隐藏训练-推理失配问题。
en_tdlr: Fair Cast fixes the hidden training-inference mismatch in RL post-training—where bf16 rounding silently discards most policy updates—with an unbiased one-line change (stochastic rounding or error feedback) at weight export.
